title: Dynamic Waters: Realistic Flowing Rivers

!!!!Official Download Notice!!!!

Dynamic Waters is officially distributed through this Modrinth page and CurseForge. You can also download the mod on CurseForge here: [https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/dynamic-waters](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/dynamic-waters) Any other websites claiming to provide downloads for this mod are not authorized by me. Unofficial downloads may be outdated, modified, incompatible, or potentially unsafe. To ensure you receive the latest and unmodified version of Dynamic Waters, always download the mod from official sources only (CurseForge or Modrinth). ***

**What is this mod?**

DynamicWaters adds dynamic, flowing rivers to Minecraft. Water is no longer static or “fake-looking” in long river shapes - instead, rivers now behave more naturally with visible flow and direction, making the world feel more alive and immersive. Main rivers are also fed by smaller mountain streams, which flow down from higher terrain and naturally connect into larger river systems, creating a much more realistic and visually cohesive world. *** ![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1505834/description_dfe8c867-8688-4d3f-b889-d39f5708cbc9.png) ***

**Why does it exist?**

In modern Minecraft versions (1.18+), rivers often feel like long, flat pools with no real movement. Older solutions like the Streams mod existed but are no longer maintained, and large mods like TerraFirmaCraft are too complex if you only want improved water physics. This mod aims to fill that missing gap. ***

**How does this mod work?**

Unlike standard flat Vanilla rivers, Dynamic Waters uses a custom, highly optimized region-based generation system. Main rivers form continuous, meandering networks at sea level. Mountain rivers are generated using an advanced drain-to-source algorithm: they start at main river junctions and work their way uphill while sampling the terrain heightmap. This allows them to naturally form flat water terraces on gentle slopes and create dramatic vertical waterfalls on steep cliffs. Thanks to a strict regional grid system (preventing chunk cascading) and heavy caching, the mod achieves strong performance, delivering realistic flowing water with no lag and minimally slower chunk generation. *** ![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1505834/description_ed89b7e9-765b-4447-948d-bd1d9b81ba64.png) ***

Compatibility (100% Working)

Dynamic Waters is designed to work alongside most modern worldgen mods. * _Note: Mods that restore, replace, or heavily modify vanilla-style rivers may conflict and lead to terrain inconsistencies._ * _Note: The mod is most likely compatible with any biome-based world generation mod, as it does not modify biome placement._ ###  **Biome & Terrain Mods:** * Regions Unexplored * Oh The Biomes We've Gone * Nature’s Spirit * Continents * Terralith * Tectonic (from v9.0.0+) * Biomes O' Plenty * William Wythers' Overhauled Overworld * Lithosphere (from v9.2.0+) * Larion (from v9.2.0+) * YUNG's Cave Biomes (fixed in v9.1.0+) * Subterranean Expansion | Cave Update * Project: Vibrant Journeys * Dynamic Trees + addons *** ![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1505834/description_226d21f0-4ded-44a3-873e-5e0206e5fc14.png) *** ### **Tech & Utilities:** * Create _(Water wheels placed in our custom rivers will generate rotational power normally!)_ * Chunky & other pre-gen mods _(fixed in v9.1.0+)_ * Physics Mod Pro _(Tip: disable flowing water textures in the config for the best look)_ ### **Special Compatibilites:** * Wavify: [https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/wavify](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/wavify) Waves in Wavify follow the natural flow of rivers, moving downstream with the current for a more realistic and immersive water simulation: *** ![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1505834/description_12b71100-95fe-46af-a665-e5e600de0f29.png) ***   ### **Incompatible mods:** * Deeper oceans(It works but some ppl had issues after loading world again) ## FAQ Q: Will there be a NeoForge 1.21.1 port?

A: Probably in the future. For now, my priority is finishing and polishing the 1.20.1 Forge version first.

**Q: Does this work on existing worlds?**

A: No - you need to create a new world. Since Dynamic Waters modifies world generation, already generated terrain will not regenerate correctly.

**Q: Will rivers become more realistic in future versions?**

A: Yes - river generation, flow behavior and terrain interaction are planned to become more advanced over time.

Q: Can I include this mod in my modpack?

A: Yes - feel free to include Dynamic Waters in your modpack without any problem. Credit is appreciated, but not required. If possible, linking back to the mod page is always welcome.
